subject: COLUMN clause
notes: Rule: 'If an entry containing a LINE clause has no subordinate entry defining a printable item, the resultant report line will be blank.' (cite.py --check 13.18.14.4 -> OK 11)). A LINE with no fields composes the space-filled buffer and returns it. Probe p1.cob (2002): `02 LINE PLUS 1.` with no subordinates between two printing lines produced an empty (blank) record in its position. Also a LINE whose only subordinate lacks COLUMN (p1 line 3 before QQ) prints nothing from it. No spec-derived golden pins a printable-less LINE; test-needed.
